title: 第22章 献上仙书第7章 凝练法力帝国神器天眼
content_zh:
治安局的天眼值守工作固然轻松自在。
不用担风险、不用费心神，可对应的薪资报酬也十分有限，每个月只有两点功勋。
这点收入放在以前尚且够用，如今却早已跟不上他的修行消耗。
对于后续可能到来的新工作、新任务，陆羽没有多少抗拒，反倒有些期待。
炼成《厚土载元身》，肉身脱胎换骨，消耗更是陡然暴涨。
一支珍贵的生命21号营养液，放在寻常修士手中能撑上十天。
到了陆羽这里，仅仅三天就会被身体彻底消化吸收干净，肉身蜕变带来的超强代谢，让他对这类滋补资源的需求远超常人。
再算上两只赤鸦道兵的日常喂养，开销更是只多不少。
罗悦之前好心投资赠送的那一整盒生命21号，这大半个月的高强度消耗下早已用光。
今天才5月15日，距离每月22号的发薪日，还有整整七天。
他手头空空，既无多余功勋兑换，兜里的现金也凑不齐三百万，根本买不起一盒新的生命21号。
万般无奈之下，陆羽只能暂时用异界猎杀的赤睛妖乌肉，暂且替代生命21号应急。
可赤睛妖乌肉终究比不上制式营养液，一只妖乌剥皮去骨，净肉不过一斤，即便混杂上蛇信村部族狩猎的野兽肉，也只能勉强撑住他一天的消耗。
而且光吃妖乌肉，陆羽总能察觉到身体里透着一股空虚感，像是营养不良般，总差了一点感觉。
帝国研发的生命21号历经多代迭代，营养配比全面又权威，远非异界野肉能够比拟。
陆羽手头的修行资源渐渐告急，若是再守着这份清闲的低薪工作，后续修行势必会陷入停滞，这也是他展望新工作的核心缘由。
他当即拉着罗悦，追问了几句换岗的事宜。
罗悦却摇头表示，新工作的落实速度没有那么快。
邪魔秘境的建设才刚刚起步，各项筹备工作繁杂，暂时还轮不到调动他这个预备人员。
估摸要等到六月中旬，才会正式给他办理换岗手续。

“还要等那么久……就算22号按时发工资，只有两点功勋，恐怕也撑不完这段日子的修行消耗，必须得想点别的办法！”
陆羽在心底暗暗琢磨，实在不行，他都打算在值守之余，找份兼职零工，多赚一笔买资源的钱。
可思来想去，他还是打定主意，把修行资源的来路放在异界之中。
相比于帝国这边修士内卷严重、资源价格贵得离谱的局面，他连通的异界更像是一片未曾开拓的蛮荒宝地。
天材地宝、妖兽肉食随处可见，获取难度远低于本土。
比较一下，陆羽自然是挑软柿子捏。
陆羽之前因为邪魔的事情在帝国这边多待了大半个月。
而在这大半个月中，异界的蛇信村部族也发生了翻天覆地的变化。
部族里的肖汉、刘阳等人，自从跟着陆羽修炼四兽拳后，本就有些底子的身躯得到全方位锤炼。
再加上两只赤鸦道兵帮忙狩猎，部族肉食供给充足，日日都能吃饱吃好，众人的身形一天比一天健壮，力气也大了不少。
真切体会到四兽拳强身健体、抵御野兽的好处后，肖汉等人早已将陆羽奉为部族仙师。
content_en:
The job of being on guard duty at the Sheriff's Bureau is certainly relaxing.
There is no need to take risks or worry, but the corresponding salary and rewards are also very limited, with only two points of merit every month.
This income was enough in the past, but now it can no longer keep up with his cultivation expenditure.
Regarding the new jobs and tasks that may come in the future, Lu Yu does not have much resistance, but is rather looking forward to them.
After refining the "Thick Earth-bearing Essence Body", the physical body is completely transformed, and the consumption increases suddenly.
A bottle of precious Life No. 21 Nutrient Solution can last ten days in the hands of an ordinary monk.
After arriving at Lu Yu's place, it would be completely digested and absorbed by the body in just three days. The super metabolism brought about by the physical transformation made his need for such nourishing resources far exceed that of ordinary people.
Including the daily feeding of the two red crow Taoist soldiers, the cost is much higher.
The entire box of Life No. 21 that Luo Yue had kindly invested in and presented as a gift had already been used up after more than half a month of intense consumption.
Today is only May 15th, and there are still seven days until the payday, which is the 22nd of every month.
He had nothing on hand, no extra merits to redeem, and he didn't have enough cash in his pocket to collect three million, so he couldn't afford a new box of Life No. 21.
In desperation, Lu Yu could only temporarily use the red-eyed demon Wurou hunted from another world to temporarily replace Life No. 21 emergency.
But after all, the red-eyed demon crow meat is not as good as the standard nutrient solution. A demon crow is skinned and deboned, and the clean meat is only a pound. Even if it is mixed with the meat of wild beasts hunted by the Shexin Village tribe, it can barely sustain him for a day.
Moreover, just eating demon black meat, Lu Yu could always feel a sense of emptiness in his body, as if he was malnourished, and he always felt a little worse.
The Life No. 21 developed by the Empire has gone through many generations of iterations, and its nutritional ratio is comprehensive and authoritative, far beyond what wild meat from other worlds can match.
Lu Yu's cultivation resources are gradually running out. If he continues to hold on to this idle, low-paying job, his subsequent cultivation will inevitably stagnate. This is also the core reason why he is looking forward to a new job.
He immediately pulled Luo Yue and asked a few questions about the changing of the guard.
Luo Yue shook his head and said that the implementation speed of the new work was not that fast.
The construction of the Demonic Secret Realm has just started, and the preparation work is complicated. It is not yet his turn to mobilize the preparatory personnel.
It is estimated that it will take until mid-June for him to be officially changed.
"We still have to wait for so long... Even if we pay wages on time on the 22nd and only have two points of merit, I'm afraid it won't be able to sustain the consumption of practice during this period. We must find other ways!"
Lu Yu secretly thought about it in his heart. If it didn't work out, he planned to find a part-time job while on duty to earn more money to buy resources.
But after much thought, he still made up his mind to find the source of his cultivation resources in another world.
Compared to the situation in the empire where the monks are seriously involved and the resources are ridiculously expensive, the other world he connects to is more like an unexplored wild treasure land.
Treasures from heaven, earth, materials and monster meat can be found everywhere, and the difficulty of obtaining them is much lower than in the mainland.
In comparison, Lu Yu naturally picks the weakest.
Lu Yu had stayed in the empire for more than half a month because of the demon incident.
In the past half month, the Shexin Village tribe in the other world has also undergone earth-shaking changes.
Xiao Han, Liu Yang and others in the tribe, since practicing Four Beast Fist with Lu Yu, their already somewhat basic bodies have been tempered in all aspects.
Coupled with the help of two red crow Taoist soldiers in hunting, the tribe has a sufficient supply of meat, and they can eat well every day. Everyone is getting stronger and stronger day by day.
After truly realizing the benefits of the Four Beast Fist to strengthen the body and resist wild beasts, Xiao Han and others have already regarded Lu Yu as a tribal immortal master.
